<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>Implement a simplified radix-2 divider on 8-bit signed or unsigned integers. and the inputs are two 8-bit operands. The module accepts a dividend and a divisor as inputs and provides a 16-bit result containing both the quotient and the remainder. The design supports both signed and unsigned division operations.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">1-bit indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">1-bit indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_ready">1-bit indicates that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit the output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
        <output id="res_valid">1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State IDLE = 2'b00;</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">State DIVIDE = 2'b01;</parameter>
        <parameter id="DONE">State DONE = 2'b10;</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <reg id="res_valid" width_description="[0:0]">1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</reg>
        <reg id="res_ready" width_description="[0:0]">1-bit indicates that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</reg>
        <reg id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit the output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</reg>
        
        <reg id="start_cnt" width_description="[0:0]">Start counter.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter.</reg>
        <reg id="neg_divisor" width_description="[8:0]">Negated divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="dividend_abs" width_description="[7:0]">Absolute value of the dividend.</reg>
        <reg id="divisor_abs" width_description="[7:0]">Absolute value of the divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="sr" width_description="[9:0]">Shift register.</reg>
        <wire id="sub_result" width_description="[9:0]">Subtraction result.</wire>
        <wire id="mux_out" width_description="[9:0]">Multiplexor output.</wire>
        <wire id="carry_out" width_description="[0:0]">Carry out.</wire>
        <assign sub_result = sr[9:0] + {1'b0,neg_divisor}; // Adder/Subtractor
        <assign mux_out = (sub_result[9]) ? sr : sub_result;
        <assign carry_out = ~sub_result[9];
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if(rst) begin
                res_valid <= 1'b0;
                res_ready <= 1'b0;
                result <= 16'd0;
                
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                neg_divisor <= 9'd0;
                dividend_abs <= 8'd0;
                divisor_abs <= 8'd0;
                sr <= 10'd0;
            end else begin
                case(cnt)
                    4'd0: begin
                        if(opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
                            dividend_abs <= (sign & dividend[7]) ? (~dividend+1'b1) : dividend;
                            divisor_abs <= (sign & divisor[7]) ? (~divisor+1'b1) : divisor;
                            neg_divisor <= ~(divisor_abs)+1'b1;
                            
                            sr <= {1'b0,dividend_abs} << 1;
                            cnt <= 4'd1;
                            start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                        end
                    end
                    
                    default: begin
                        if(start_cnt) begin
                            if(cnt[3]) begin
                                cnt <= 4'd0;
                                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                                
                                sr <= mux_out;
                                result <= {sr[9:1],carry_out};
                                res_valid <= 1'b1;
                            end else begin
                                cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
                                sr <= {mux_out[8:0],carry_out};
                            end
                        end
                    end
                endcase
                
                if(res_valid && res_ready) begin
                    res_valid <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Design your implementation here!</implementation>
</module>
